title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling samples, and docs quickstarts
author: Maya Singh
description: Context: Add canonical RAG agent templates and end-to-end tool-calling quickstarts to make it easier for engineers to prototype retrieval-augmented agents and tool integrations. This PR introduces YAML templates, TypeScript/Python example clients, and docs site quickstarts. Motivation: reduce onboarding friction for teams adopting RAG + agents, provide vetted tool-calling examples, and keep docs and examples in sync. Changes include lightweight templates for common patterns (retriever->tool->response), a sample local tool server, and updated docs with step-by-step instructions and minimal config. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates (basic, conversational, tool-calling) - [x] Add TypeScript + Python quickstart examples - [x] Add docs quickstart page + nav entry - [x] Add CI example test to validate example runs - [x] Update redwood-examples README - [x] Add release notes entry Summary of commits: - feat: add basic and conversational RAG agent YAML templates - feat: add tool-calling agent template and sample tool server example - feat: add TS quickstart client and scripts for local testing - feat: add Python quickstart example and README - docs: add rag-agent quickstart guide and nav entry - test: add CI job that runs quickstart smoke tests - chore: small lint fixes and example README updates Files changed: redwood-examples/rag/templates/basic_agent.yaml, redwood-examples/rag/templates/conversational_agent.yaml, redwood-examples/rag/templates/tool_calling_agent.yaml, redwood-examples/playbooks/tool_server/example_tool_server.py, redwood-examples/ts/agent-quickstart.ts, redwood-examples/py/agent_quickstart.py, redwood-docs/docs/guides/rag-agent-quickstart.md, redwood-docs/site/nav.yaml Notes on implementation: - Templates are intentionally minimal and documented inline (comments) to encourage iteration. - Tool-calling example demonstrates both sync and async tool invocation with the same agent template; the agent uses a small JSON contract for tool inputs/outputs. - Quickstarts include environment variable examples for API keys and optional dedicated model tuning flags. - CI: added a smoke job that starts the example tool server in a container and runs the TS quickstart against the hosted API (mock credentials). Known limitations & follow-ups: - Windows testing not yet included (tracked as ENG-8479). - Add more advanced eval-driven templates in a follow-up PR (ENG-8502). Related Linear: ENG-8421, PM-391. Links: docs quickstart: /docs/guides/rag-agent-quickstart, examples dir: redwood-examples/rag. Review conversation (high-level): - Lucas Chen: requested clearer error handling in the tool server and tests; asked for a small integration smoke test. - Author (Maya): added retry on tool startup and CI smoke job in a follow-up commit. - Ava Patel: asked to make the TS quickstart use the SDK's streaming helper; author updated example and added note in docs. - Diego Ramirez: approved after CI green and minor lint fix. CI: one flaky lint run initially failed, fixed in second commit; integration smoke tests pass. Merge: squashed and merged to main on 2026-02-25 (merge commit a1b2c3d4e5f6).
